title: Move the Welsh language link below the beta banner
why:
The Welsh language link now sits below the beta banner, on the right, on every regulator page. It was in the service navigation.

**Why**

- It's in the same place as the [regulator toolkit prototype](https://regulator-responsibility-app-359d82a07820.herokuapp.com/v4/regulator-index--dashboard?persona=basic-user)'s link, so regulator services stay consistent
- The service navigation stays free for menu items, the signed-in person and Sign out
- The [GOV.UK language navigation guidance](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/language-navigation/) says to choose a single consistent location that works for your users. The service navigation is one option, not a rule

**What hasn't changed**

- It's still the GOV.UK language navigation component (in trial), with only GOV.UK override classes to place it
- It's still its own navigation landmark ("Language"), so screen reader users can find it
- Cymraeg is still marked as Welsh, so screen readers say it in Welsh (WCAG 3.1.2, language of parts)

**To be confirmed**

Where the link goes in the shared regulator header, with the shared components team.
